protocol.latent_cluster_probability: p_j = 0.5 +/- 0.5*sqrt(ICC), with the two signs selected equiprobably and independently per cluster
protocol.conditional_instance_model: Bernoulli(p_j) within cluster; clusters independent; marginal win probability is 0.5 and within-cluster Bernoulli ICC equals the configured value
protocol.signed_effect_magnitude: Uniform(0.5, 1.5), independent of sign, to avoid deterministic median ties
protocol.naive_method: Exact one-sided sign test on all 100 instance-level signs as if independent
protocol.cluster_method: Take the median signed effect within each family, then exact one-sided sign test across 10 independent family medians
protocol.monte_carlo_interval: 95% Wilson score interval for empirical rejection proportion
protocol.family_reduction: Sort signed continuous effects within each family and use their median; for even family sizes, the median is the arithmetic mean of the two central signed effects.
protocol.random_draw_order: For each instance, draw its Bernoulli sign and then draw its independent Uniform(0.5, 1.5) magnitude before proceeding to the next instance.

interpretation.main_finding: Using the specified cluster-median reduction, the naive instance-level sign test becomes increasingly anti-conservative as within-family dependence increases under this declared null model. The cluster-median test remains below 5% in every tested ICC cell.
interpretation.discreteness: At 10 independent clusters, a one-sided exact sign test rejects at alpha=0.05 only with at least 9 cluster wins; its attainable type-I error is 11/1024 (about 1.07%), so the cluster result is deliberately conservative and may have low power.
limitations: Only one balanced cluster-size design is used in the Monte Carlo ICC sweep
The exchangeable two-point latent-probability model is not a universal model of benchmark dependence
No power analysis, heterogeneous treatment effects or missingness stress is included here
Simulation does not validate independence or representativeness of a real quantum benchmark suite

The frozen results use the exact signed-magnitude median reduction, including the sign of the mean of the two central values for even cluster sizes; a count-majority-only implementation will not reproduce the fixture.
